title: Wild AG header
description: A bare header over full-bleed footage: a thin, widely tracked paper wordmark at the left and a two-bar burger at the right (its lower bar halves on hover). Past the first screen a compact pair drops in at the top right: a gradient 'Contact' pill and a round paper burger disc. The burger opens a full-window paper menu of large uppercase links that turn to the brand gradient on hover.
notes: it overlays the top of the page (absolute) with paper-coloured marks: the first section should be dark footage or a gradient band
the compact pair appears after the page scrolls past `threshold` (a fraction of the window height)
desktop layout inferred: on the original the intro curtain hid the header in every desktop frame
name: wild-ag-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the brand name, set as a thin wordmark

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: screen-reader labels of the burger and the menu's close button

props.name: contact
props.description: the pill in the compact bar and at the foot of the menu

props.name: threshold
props.description: how far the page scrolls, as a fraction of the window height, before the compact bar drops in
